meta.name: add-anydoc
meta.description: Add local office-document-to-Markdown conversion to NanoClaw agent containers with the pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI. Use when agents need to read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF files without uploading them to a hosted parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让你的智能助手直接读懂本地各类办公文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的智能助手需要读取本地办公文档却不便上传到云端
copy.tagline_en: Let your AI agent read local office documents directly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI agent to read local office docs without uploading them.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在 NanoClaw 的 agent 容器里用固定版本的 Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI，把随附的 Word、PowerPoint、Excel 等办公文档在本地转成 Markdown，不上传到托管解析服务。
howto.when: 当 agent 需要读取随附的 Word、PowerPoint、Excel 等办公文档，或要把本地办公文档转成 Markdown、不使用托管解析服务时触发。

say.text: 把这份附件转成 Markdown，并总结关键章节
把这份 Excel 转成 Markdown 表格
say.note: 表格 Markdown 不能用作计算的依据

say.text: 先确认这个 PDF 有文字层，再转成 Markdown
say.note: 纯图片 PDF 会失败，且不会被上传

howto.what_en: Installs the pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI and a container skill so Claude converts attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, RTF, EPUB, CSV and text-based PDF files to Markdown, locally inside the agent container rather than on a hosted parser.
howto.when_en: Use when agents need to read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV or text-based PDF files without uploading them to a hosted parser.

say_en.text: Convert this attachment to Markdown and summarize the key sections
Turn this XLSX into a Markdown table
say_en.note: Spreadsheet Markdown is not authoritative for calculations

say_en.text: Convert this PDF only if it has a text layer; if image-only, tell me
say_en.note: Image-only PDFs fail; nothing is uploaded
